observed_failure: All three UI tests timed out waiting for Switch.value == '1' (value remained empty); native Accessibility tree represented the checked Compose Switch with the Selected trait.
diagnosis: Test observation mismatch; not evidence that the app preference toggle failed.
correction: Use XCUIElement.isSelected and seed a fresh simulator app container before each independent test case.

observed_failure: Every queue/restore test failed 'Restored the wrong song' with mini player showing Restore check A at 0:42 / 0:00 (index ignored), and the translation chip test failed because the tapped FilterChip lost the Selected trait mid-wait.
diagnosis: Two root causes: (1) launch-argument queue value contained raw tab/newline characters; on the runner's simulator the argv path mangled them so decodeQueue saw fewer fields and the third line failed to parse, and integerForKey/doubleForKey converted the string-typed '-music.index'/'-music.position' values unreliably (index stayed 0). (2) FilterChip selected state is not a stable accessibility trait under this harness; proven tappable control is Switch (music-restore-position).
correction: Added -music.queueSeed: argv carries backslash-escaped text decoded by commonMain unescapeQueueSeed into the native codec; MusicStore reads NSNumber/NSString itself (longDefault/doubleDefault/boolDefault) instead of integerForKey/doubleForKey; translation/romanization/visibility toggles now use Switch with the same testTags. Committed 5fbc5a6, JVM 76 pass, production dry-run passed (1577 files, c0ecf959).

observed_failure: Same step 19 failure family: 7 tests 'Restored the wrong song' plus translation-chip state wait timeout.
diagnosis: Same two causes as run 2 (raw-control-char argv queue + string-typed index; FilterChip trait). Romanization/queue source fixes themselves never reached a render assertion because setUp failed first.
correction: Covered by the 5fbc5a6 fix above; romanization cases rerun there.

acceptance: 10/11 evidence captured, not accepted until full green + physical-device notice delivery check
